author: MattVidPro
description: Adds layered stereoscopic 3D and quality-of-life improvements to Terraria (USA) using a Luma3DS plugin. Developed with Claude AI, directed and hardware-tested by MattVidPro.
long_description:
A Luma3DS 3GX plugin for Terraria (USA), title ID **000400000016A900**, updated to **v5.6.0**. Adds layered stereoscopic depth, inventory sorting, larger stacks and other quality-of-life improvements.

Choose **New 3DS** for New 3DS, New 3DS XL or New 2DS XL. Choose **Old 3DS** for the original 3DS, 3DS XL or 2DS. The Old 3DS build uses a lighter four-layer 3D implementation and a 30 fps lock. Both choices install to the same path; install only the build for your console. 2DS models can use compatible plugin features but cannot display stereoscopic 3D.

Requires **Luma3DS v13.0 or newer**. Enable the plugin loader in the Rosalina menu, launch Terraria, then press **SELECT** for the plugin menu. You must provide your own copy of the game; no game files are included.

Developed by Claude (Anthropic AI), with MattVidPro directing development and testing on real New 3DS and Old 3DS hardware. Unofficial fan mod, not affiliated with Re-Logic, 505 Games or Nintendo.
